description: Returns the framework’s research on one AI product and plan: its facts, the governance considerations found, and the cited sources with their review dates. Accepts a profile id or a product name.

controls.description: Optional control ids, such as "trainingUse" or "inferenceRegion", to return only those considerations.

product.description: A profile id from search_library, or a product name such as "Claude Team".

name: get_software_profile
title: Get a software profile
